title: Worker view pointer heap preparation
summary: Recover the bottom-up max-heap construction on a half-open range of worker-view pointers, ordered by the signed field at offset 0x188.
test_description: Compare exact pointer permutations with the original for lengths 0 through 96, ascending, descending, equal, duplicate, extreme and pseudorandom signed keys; check heap ordering, range sentinels, object bytes and FS head restoration.
known_limits: The identity and semantics of the field at offset 0x188 are unresolved.
Requires a valid half-open range of pointers to readable objects, with a representable range length; malformed pointers and enormous ranges are not tested.
This recovers heap preparation only, not the enclosing sort or later heap extraction.
